A gem of a restaurant near Hue
Jul 2026 • Couples
What a discovery! While looking for a restaurant near the tombs of Hue, we came across the good reviews for Ama restaurant.
A brilliant stop in a heavenly setting, the restaurant overlooks the magnificent garden and the pool of this high-end resort. The setting is nothing but refinement and comfort with impeccable service. The highlight is the food... high-end Vietnamese gastronomy, nothing like the restaurants in Hue, even the best-rated ones we tested with disappointment; here everything is delicious and the flavors are spot on, my compliments to the chef because we are difficult guests.
In short, even if it takes a good fifteen minutes from Hue, frankly you will not regret the trip, I loved our two lunches. Thank you for this moment with incredible value for money.

Tranquil experience at Anhill/Ama restaurant
Jan 2026 • Couples
We stayed at the Anhill Boutique and ate at the Ama restaurant and we would definitely recommend a visit if you’re in Hue. The restaurant is situated in the tranquil surroundings of the Hotel grounds. Dinner was accompanied by the gentle sound of water and the occasional frog call - it is a wonderful setting. We had a range of Vietnamese dishes - all of which were delicious. The cocktails were top class. But above all the service was amongst the best we have received in Vietnam. The staff are amazingly friendly, quietly efficient and nothing is any trouble for them. Definitely recommend
